answer: A defence is pre-registration. Before grading opens, each identity posts a salted hash of the mechanism it will argue; settlement pays only text matching that hash. Because the hash binds before peers reveal answers, a farm cannot hold many keys as a free option and fill each with whichever thesis wins. Every key must decide blind and pay for its own reasoning, and a mismatch voids it and cuts the bond. An attacker's advantage reaches its zenith on the first key and decays from there: identities become islands of unshared work, and the only thread between them is a budget spent once per key.
